scene: tipping a wet black umbrella away from a lit café doorway at night, other hand in the coat pocket

intro.ko: 차콜 울 코트 아래 검정 터틀넥을 입고, 젖은 우산은 카페 문 밖으로 기울였다.
intro.en: A black turtleneck sits under the charcoal wool coat as he tips his wet umbrella away from the café door.
intro.de: Unter dem anthrazitfarbenen Wollmantel trägt er einen schwarzen Rollkragen. Den nassen Schirm hält er von der Cafétür weg.

deck.ko: 카페에 들어서기 전 문 앞에서 우산의 빗물을 털어 내는, 차콜과 회색으로 맞춘 저녁 차림.
deck.en: Charcoal and grey for a wet evening, with one last shake of the umbrella before going in.
deck.de: Anthrazit und Grau für einen nassen Abend – der Schirm wird vor dem Hineingehen noch einmal ausgeschüttelt.

copy.pull: SHAKE IT OFF BEFORE YOU GO IN.

tip.ko: 가는 비가 오는 저녁엔 울 코트에 맺힌 물방울을 문 앞에서 가볍게 털고 들어가요.
tip.en: On a drizzly evening, brush the drops off a wool coat at the door before you go inside.
tip.de: An einem Nieselabend die Tropfen vor der Tür leicht vom Wollmantel streichen, bevor man hineingeht.

copy.note: title and body are the producer copy (Korean master) verbatim; deck, pull and tip written by Claude Code from the editorial (not in the delivery); English product names only sentence-cased (sourceNameEn)

howToWear.en: Leave the coat open at the collar to show the rollneck.
howToWear.de: Den Mantel am Kragen offen lassen, damit der Rollkragen sichtbar bleibt.

howToWear.ko: 회색 목도리 아래 검정 터틀넥을 겹쳐 입는다.
howToWear.en: Layer the black rollneck beneath the grey scarf.
howToWear.de: Den schwarzen Rollkragen unter dem grauen Schal tragen.

howToWear.ko: 젖은 포장에 끌리지 않도록 바짓단을 부츠 위에 둔다.
howToWear.en: Keep the trouser hems above the wet pavement.
howToWear.de: Die Hosensäume über dem nassen Pflaster halten.

howToWear.ko: 굽이 낮고 밑창에 홈이 있는 첼시 부츠를 신는다.
howToWear.en: Wear low-heeled Chelsea boots with a treaded sole.
howToWear.de: Chelsea-Boots mit niedrigem Absatz und Profilsohle tragen.

products.spec: heather charcoal short ribbed fisherman beanie

name.en: Heather charcoal short ribbed fisherman beanie

products.sourceNameEn: heather charcoal short ribbed fisherman beanie

howToWear.ko: 밴드를 한 번 접어 귀 위에 맞춘다.
howToWear.en: Fold the cuff once and set it above the ears.
howToWear.de: Den Umschlag einmal falten und über den Ohren tragen.

howToWear.ko: 목에 한 번 감고 긴 끝을 코트 앞으로 내린다.
howToWear.en: Loop it once and let the long end fall over the coat front.
howToWear.de: Einmal wickeln und das lange Ende vor dem Mantel hängen lassen.

howToWear.ko: 문 밖으로 우산을 기울여 물기를 턴다.
howToWear.en: Tip the umbrella outside the doorway to drain it.
howToWear.de: Den Schirm draußen vor der Tür abtropfen lassen.
